sections.text:
Ability Power 170. Damages all enemies 3 times with physical light damage with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Activates the following effects for all allies that have light element cast upon them:
-Heals the HP of all allies with Ability Power 70.
-Increases the critical hit chance of all allies by 40% for 60 seconds.
